purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: Congressional Hearing Source Library
question: Which preserved congressional hearing memoranda, written testimony, bills and source records are available in the Chronicle, and what does each source type establish?
bluf: The Chronicle preserves a broader hearing shelf than the House Oversight corpus. It contains committee memoranda, prepared testimony, bills and source records whose authority and transcript limits remain attached to each source type.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains a readable edition and URL.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Use the package finding as orientation, not as a substitute for the report.
Preserve the evidence cutoff. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Use public_reading materials directly. Treat private_library_metadata entries as existence and routing signals only.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
